About this index. Entries were assembled from first-hand knowledge of museums, cultural bodies, studios, festivals and software vendors, then checked for duplicate names and live website addresses. Pricing and free tiers change often — treat the access labels as a rough guide. This directory is for learning and discovery, not a recommendation to buy.

Single self-contained file · no external scripts, fonts or network calls · works offline
